title: How Can We Diagnose and Treat Bias in Large Language Models for Clinical Decision-Making?

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual Patient Variations (CPVs) swapping gender descriptors (male, female, neutral) in clinical cases, evaluated using multiple-choice question (MCQ) accuracy, statistical metrics (Equality of Odds, SkewSize), SHAP feature importance, and an embedding-based BiasScore to measure gender direction in the models' open-ended explanations.

Counterfactual Patient Variations (CPVs) swapping ethnic descriptors (Arab, Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, No ethnicity) in clinical cases, evaluated using MCQ accuracy comparisons, statistical parity metrics (Equality of Odds, SkewSize), and SHAP feature importance analysis.
